definitions.explanation: Money given to the bereaved family at funerals or memorial services. Presented in special envelopes with appropriate formatting.
A euphemism for death, funerals, or other unfortunate events.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY: {不|ふ} (un-, non-) + ⟦{祝儀|しゅうぎ}→祝儀：06225_shuugi⟧ (congratulatory gift). Literally "non-celebratory gift," a euphemism for funeral money.

CONTRAST WITH ⟦{祝儀|しゅうぎ}→祝儀：06225_shuugi⟧:
- ⟦{祝儀|しゅうぎ}→祝儀：06225_shuugi⟧: money given at happy events (weddings, births)
- {不祝儀|ぶしゅうぎ}: money given at sad events (funerals, memorials)

ENVELOPE ETIQUETTE:
- Use {不祝儀|ぶしゅうぎ}⟦{袋|ぶくろ}→袋：00837_fukuro⟧ (special mourning envelopes)
- Black and white or silver ties on envelope
- Write name in ⟦{薄墨|うすずみ}→薄墨：29763_usuzumi⟧ (light ink) traditionally
- Never use new bills (fold them once first)

APPROPRIATE AMOUNTS (general guide):
- ⟦{知人|ちじん}→知人：04056_chijin⟧ (acquaintance): 3,000-5,000⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧
- ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧ (friend): 5,000-10,000⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧
- ⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧ (relative): 10,000-50,000⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧
- ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧ (parent): 50,000-100,000⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧
